## Declarations and implementations

```plato

//==
// # IImage processing - compositing
//
// How two layers combine: the color-mixing blend modes familiar from image
// editors and CSS, and the Porter-Duff operators that decide how source and
// destination *coverage* (alpha) combine. Both are pure data consumed by
// compositing functions in a later pass.

//==
// ## Compositing

// How a source color combines with a destination color when layered
// (Photoshop/CSS blend modes). (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blend_modes)
type BlendMode
    = Normal
    | Multiply
    | Screen
    | Overlay
    | Darken
    | Lighten
    | ColorDodge
    | ColorBurn
    | HardLight
    | SoftLight
    | Difference
    | Exclusion
    | Hue
    | Saturation
    | Color
    | Luminosity
    | Add
    | Subtract
    | Divide;

// A Porter-Duff alpha-compositing operator: how source and destination
// coverage combine. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alpha_compositing)
type PorterDuff
    = Clear
    | Source
    | Destination
    | SourceOver
    | DestinationOver
    | SourceIn
    | DestinationIn
    | SourceOut
    | DestinationOut
    | SourceAtop
    | DestinationAtop
    | Xor
    | Plus;

//==
// # IImage processing - filters and morphology
//
// Neighborhood operations: convolution kernels and the blurs and sharpeners
// built from them, edge detectors, mathematical morphology, and thresholding.
// These are parameter records - pure data consumed by processing functions in
// a later pass. Distances and radii are in pixels unless noted.

//==
// ## Convolution and blurs

// A dense 2D convolution kernel. Weights are row-major, Width times Height
// entries; odd dimensions center the kernel on the target pixel. Each output
// is the weighted sum times Scale plus Bias.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kernel_(image_processing))
type ConvolutionKernel
    implements IValue
{
    Width: Integer;
    Height: Integer;
    Weights: Array<Number>;
    Scale: Number;
    Bias: Number;
}

// A separable convolution: a horizontal pass then a vertical pass, equivalent
// to convolving with the outer product of the two tap arrays but far cheaper.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Separable_filter)
type SeparableKernel
    implements IValue
{
    HorizontalTaps: Array<Number>;
    VerticalTaps: Array<Number>;
}

// Gaussian blur settings. Radius bounds the kernel extent in pixels; a Sigma
// of 0 or less derives the standard deviation from Radius.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gaussian_blur)
type GaussianBlurParameters
    implements IValue
{
    Radius: Integer;
    Sigma: Number;
}

// Box blur settings: a uniform square average of the given radius, repeated
// Passes times (three passes closely approximate a Gaussian).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Box_blur)
type BoxBlurParameters
    implements IValue
{
    Radius: Integer;
    Passes: Integer;
}

// Linear motion blur: smearing along a direction over a distance in pixels.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Motion_blur_(media))
type MotionBlurParameters
    implements IValue
{
    Angle: Angle;
    Distance: Number;
}

// Unsharp-mask sharpening: Amount scales the high-frequency difference added
// back; Radius is the blur extent; Threshold suppresses sharpening where the
// local difference is below it (noise protection).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unsharp_masking)
type UnsharpMaskParameters
    implements IValue
{
    Radius: Number;
    Amount: Number;
    Threshold: Number;
}

//==
// ## Edges, morphology, and thresholds

// An edge-detection operation. Canny carries its two hysteresis thresholds;
// the other operators carry a single magnitude cutoff.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Edge_detection)
type EdgeDetection
    = Sobel(Threshold: Number)
    | Prewitt(Threshold: Number)
    | Scharr(Threshold: Number)
    | Laplacian(Threshold: Number)
    | LaplacianOfGaussian(Threshold: Number)
    | Canny(LowThreshold: Number, HighThreshold: Number);

// A mathematical-morphology operation; Gradient is dilation minus erosion.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mathematical_morphology)
type MorphologyOperation
    = Erode | Dilate | Open | Close | TopHat | BlackHat | Gradient;

// The neighborhood shape a morphological operation sweeps over the image.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Structuring_element)
type StructuringElement = Box | Disk | Cross | Diamond;
```
